_meta.purpose: Index of the WMXIX create-a-wrestler (CAW) part library for the Western Heart Creation Suite. The 2,690 part files themselves live on the ISO/release side (streamed 2026-10-13, 54.3 MB) and are cataloged — not duplicated — by teardown/wmxix/caw-parts/files.tsv. This index is the wiring point: Creation Suite lanes consume parts by category from the catalog.
_meta.game_consumer_today: game/js/custom-fighter.js reads Creation Suite profiles (localStorage wh_creation_suite_v1 / wh_create_fighter_v1); it does not yet read this part catalog — part-level consumption is Creation Suite work, flagged to coordinator.

format_notes: YOBJ v00030001 x754 + v00040001 x175 + v00040002 x32 + v00040003 x31 are real part geometry (same YOBJ family as wrestler assembly, solved — assemble_wrestler_v2). DUMY placeholders x202 carry no geometry. Texture parts are GameCube TPL/.tex — decode via teardown/wmxix/decode_tpl.py (validated, mean abs diff 4.2/255 vs artist source).
